items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: As a matter of fact my first gig was with the band she was with before I started the New Tones you know.

ctx.x: And then she was gigging anyway. As a matter of fact my first gig was with the band she was with before I started the New Tones you know. Because she could read music so if they wanted to play “All the Things You Are” or “Stella by Starlight,” she would play it correctly and she knew that she played it, and the chords over and over again, the same structure. But they kept being after her about soloing you know. And she didn’t want to solo. She didn’t want to improvise. She didn’t want to play something and not…
How did that work for you? Did you stumble into improvising because it was required or did you really seek it out beforehand?
